question: Indulgeo Essentials brand manufacturer company
markdown:
Indulgeo Essentials
is an Indian organic clean-beauty brand. It is manufactured and retailed under its parent company,
Paarvi Retails Pvt. Ltd.
, based in Bahadurgarh, Haryana, India.
